actions.value:
set +e
date -u +%FT%T.%N
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=2s 8s /bin/sh <<'GJS_AVAILABILITY'
command -v gjs
path_rc=$?
printf 'GJS_COMMAND_PATH_EXIT=%s\n' "$path_rc"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1s 4s gjs --version
version_rc=$?
printf 'GJS_VERSION_EXIT=%s\n' "$version_rc"
printf 'GJS_AVAILABILITY_COMPLETE\n'
test "$path_rc" -eq 0 && test "$version_rc" -eq 0
GJS_AVAILABILITY
rc=$?
printf 'GJS_AVAILABILITY_WHOLE_EXIT=%s\n' "$rc"
date -u +%FT%T.%N
exit "$rc"
